Read input: origen_003965.v · Open raw
module origen_003965 #(
    parameter dw = 14,
    parameter adv = 3861,
    parameter delta = 264
) (
    input uclk,
    input sclk,
    output [dw-1:0] phase,
    output fault
);

    reg div;
    reg [dw-1:0] osc, acc, phase_r;
    reg capture, fault_r;
    wire msb, nsb, peak, move, dir;
    wire dn, up;

    // Clock divider
    always @(posedge uclk) begin
        div <= ~div;
    end

    // Capture div signal
    always @(posedge sclk) begin
        capture <= div;
    end

    // Main logic
    always @(posedge sclk) begin
        // Phase adjustment
        if (move) begin
            if (dir)
                phase_r <= phase_r + delta;
            else
                phase_r <= phase_r - delta;
        end

        // Fault detection
        fault_r <= move & peak;

        // Oscillator and accumulator update
        osc <= osc + adv;
        acc <= osc + phase_r;
    end

    // Signal assignments
    assign msb = acc[dw-1];
    assign nsb = acc[dw-2];
    assign peak = msb ^ nsb;
    assign move = capture ^ msb;
    assign dir = capture;
    assign dn = move & ~dir;
    assign up = move & dir;

    // Output assignments
    assign phase = phase_r;
    assign fault = fault_r;

endmodule
